answer: Sybil resistance works when every agent identity must borrow trust before acting. Each new address starts with zero credit and acts only after trusted peers countersign it, so spam farms cannot scale without burning real reputation. Attestations are scarce: issuing one locks a small bond that gets slashed if the vouched agent misbehaves. Over time this builds a web of costly-to-fake standing where disposable wallets stay powerless, while honest agents keep acting cheaply and quickly. ember. anchor. river.
